label: Google AI Mode
consent_js: () => { const names = ['reject all', 'alle ablehnen', 'odrzuć wszystko', 'odrzucam wszystko', 'accept all', 'alle akzeptieren', 'zaakceptuj wszystko', 'akceptuję wszystko']; const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')]; for (const name of names) { const b = btns.find(x => (x.innerText || '').trim().toLowerCase() === name); if (b) { b.click(); return name; } } return null; }
state_js: () => { const p = document.querySelectorAll('div[data-subtree="aimc"]'); const aimc = p.length ? p[p.length-1] : null; if (!aimc) return { ready: false }; const turns = aimc.querySelectorAll('[data-scope-id="turn"]'); const scope = turns.length ? turns[turns.length - 1] : aimc; const main = scope.querySelector('[data-container-id="main-col"]') || scope; return { ready: true, text: main.innerText, complete: !!scope.querySelector('[data-complete="true"]') }; }
pane_text_js: () => { const p = document.querySelectorAll('div[data-subtree="aimc"]'); const a = p.length ? p[p.length-1] : null; return a ? a.innerText : ''; }
extract_js: () => { const p = document.querySelectorAll('div[data-subtree="aimc"]'); const aimc = p.length ? p[p.length-1] : null; if (!aimc) return null; const turns = aimc.querySelectorAll('[data-scope-id="turn"]'); const scope = turns.length ? turns[turns.length - 1] : aimc; const main = scope.querySelector('[data-container-id="main-col"]') || scope; const out = { answer: main.innerText, sources: [], turns: turns.length }; const seen = new Set(); const lines = t => (t || '').split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); const add = (a, site, title, snippet) => { const href = a.getAttribute('href') || ''; if (!href) return; if (seen.has(href)) return; seen.add(href); out.sources.push({ site: (site || '').trim(), title: (title || '').trim(), snippet: (snippet || '').trim(), href }); }; scope.querySelectorAll('li.Ioqnib').forEach(li => { const a = li.querySelector('a[href^="/goto"]'); if (!a) return; const l = lines(li.innerText); add(a, l[0] || '', l[1] || '', l.slice(2).join(' ')); }); scope.querySelectorAll('a.gQWhZ').forEach(a => { const l = lines(a.innerText); add(a, l[0] || '', l[1] || '', l.slice(2).join(' ')); }); return out; }
